name: FiberState Datacenter

profile.reading: Per FiberState own site, the company lists 106 East 13200 South, Draper, Utah as its main office address; a separate FiberState Salt Lake City Data Center section describes colocation, dedicated servers, peering, and IP transit services with named carrier and exchange partners, but does not state whether the data center occupies this same Draper address or a different one. That address is recorded here as unconfirmed for the data center itself rather than adopted outright. No square footage or power capacity in MW is published.
